name: economist-podcast-studio
description: Vertical-first, source-linked Economist podcast production with issue-cover openings, rotating article media, editorial Chinese titles, and static-slide video rendering.

interface.longDescription: A vertical-first local production plugin for extracting one selected Economist article, freezing source-bounded conversational scripts and captions, creating content-led Chinese publishing titles, and rendering 9:16 or 16:9 static-slide videos with a verified issue-cover opening and rotating article media.
defaultPrompt: Run the vertical-first local Economist article-to-podcast-video workflow.
Extract one selected Economist article from a PDF.
Turn a verified Economist article into a natural podcast script.
Generate the selected podcast audio, captions, and static-slide video.
